description:
Item from EuroQol- 5 Dimension (EQ-5D), a five-dimension descriptive system to assess generic-quality of life. Higher scores indicate greater mobility limitations. [EuroQol Research Foundation. EQ-5D-3L User Guide, 2018.](https://euroqol.org/publications/user-guides)

[Search for all EQ-5D variables within this dataset](https://sleepdata.org/loftdatasets/lofthf/variables?search=eq5d)
